items.title: Ronnie Zito interviewed by Monk Rowe & Rick Montalbano, via Zoom, March 9, 2022
items.q: I stayed there for four years. I did it for four years with him.

ctx.x: When you got tapped to go with Bobby Darin, was there any question about doing it? Did you —

Oh yeah. I said to Tony, Bobby asked me if I could go with him for six weeks. Right? Or something like that. He didn’t say I want you to be my drummer right away. And he says I’ve got this gig in Washington, DC. So I spoke to Tony about it and Tony says, “Go, man, go ahead. You’re young, go ahead, just do it.” By that time I was playing, because I was at Three Rivers for about two or three years and I was playing real good, my reading got real good, because you’re playing different music every week you know. So…
